agents.name: ORION
agents.label: Volume spike on a green candle
agents.rule: volume >= 3x its 20-bar average, green body >= 50% of range

agents.name: VEGA
agents.label: Inside bar breakdown
agents.rule: an inside bar, then a close below the mother bar's low

agents.name: NOVA
agents.label: Big green candle (momentum ignition)
agents.rule: green, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

agents.name: ATLAS
agents.label: P6 opening range breakout (Jarvus)
agents.rule: scripts/ladder.py s_orb

agents.name: LYRA
agents.label: NR7 breakout up
agents.rule: prior bar has the narrowest range of 7, then a close above its high

agents.name: TITAN
agents.label: MFI above 80
agents.rule: MFI(14) crosses above 80

agents.name: AEGIS
agents.label: Break of structure up (trend continuation)
agents.rule: higher highs and higher lows, then a close above the last swing high

agents.name: HELIOS
agents.label: Big 24h rally (momentum)
agents.rule: 24h return crosses above 2.5x its average absolute 24h move (30 days)

agents.name: SIRIUS
agents.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
agents.rule: close crosses above BB(20,2) upper band (breakout reading)

agents.name: KEPLER
agents.label: Five green candles in a row
agents.rule: 5 consecutive green closes

agents.name: POLARIS
agents.label: Breakout confirmed by OBV
agents.rule: close and OBV both at new 20-bar highs

agents.name: RIGEL
agents.label: Inside bar
agents.rule: high below and low above the prior bar's

agents.name: CYGNUS
agents.label: Big 24h rally (momentum)
agents.rule: 24h return crosses above 2.5x its average absolute 24h move (30 days)

agents.name: DRACO
agents.label: Prior-day high breakout
agents.rule: first close above yesterday's high that day

agents.name: PULSAR
agents.label: Spinning top
agents.rule: body 10-30% of range, both wicks >= the body

agents.name: QUASAR
agents.label: Shooting star
agents.rule: inverted-hammer shape after a 5-bar rise

agents.name: ZENITH
agents.label: Donchian 20 breakout
agents.rule: close above the prior 20-bar high

agents.name: AURORA
agents.label: Hanging man
agents.rule: hammer shape after a 5-bar rise

agents.name: BOREAS
agents.label: Floor pivot R1 rejection
agents.rule: trades above R1 and closes back below it

agents.name: CALYPSO
agents.label: RSI(2) below 10
agents.rule: RSI(2) crosses below 10

agents.name: CASSINI
agents.label: RSI(2) below 10 above the 200 SMA (Connors)
agents.rule: RSI(2) crosses below 10 while close > SMA(200)

agents.name: CEPHEUS
agents.label: Stochastic RSI bullish cross below 0.2
agents.rule: StochRSI(14) K crosses above D below 0.2

agents.name: ELARA
agents.label: RSI bearish divergence
agents.rule: close above the highest close of bars 5-20 back while RSI(14) is >= 3 lower than at that high (which was > 65)

agents.name: EOS
agents.label: RSI(2) dip (Jarvus)
agents.rule: scripts/ladder.py s_rsi2

agents.name: GAIA
agents.label: CCI above +100 (momentum)
agents.rule: CCI(20) crosses above +100

agents.name: HALO
agents.label: Hammer
agents.rule: after a 5-bar drop; lower wick >= 2x body; upper wick <= 10% of range; body >= 5% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: HERMES
agents.label: Doji after a rise
agents.rule: after a 5-bar rise; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: HYDRA
agents.label: Big green candle (momentum ignition)
agents.rule: green, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

agents.name: HYPERION
agents.label: Keltner channel breakout
agents.rule: close crosses above EMA(20) + 2 ATR

agents.name: ICARUS
agents.label: Five green candles in a row
agents.rule: 5 consecutive green closes

agents.name: JUNO
agents.label: MACD crosses below signal
agents.rule: MACD line crosses below its signal line

agents.name: MIRA
agents.label: Doji after a rise
agents.rule: after a 5-bar rise; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: NYX
agents.label: Donchian 55 breakout (turtle)
agents.rule: close above the prior 55-bar high

agents.name: OBERON
agents.label: Outside bar, down close
agents.rule: range covers the prior bar and closes below the prior low

agents.name: PALLAS
agents.label: Donchian 55 breakout (turtle)
agents.rule: close above the prior 55-bar high

agents.name: PHOEBE
agents.label: Bearish engulfing
agents.rule: after a 5-bar rise; green then red whose body covers the green body

agents.name: RHEA
agents.label: MFI above 80
agents.rule: MFI(14) crosses above 80

agents.name: SELENE
agents.label: Prior-day high breakout
agents.rule: first close above yesterday's high that day

agents.name: SPICA
agents.label: EMA 9/21 bearish cross
agents.rule: EMA(9) crosses below EMA(21)

agents.name: TALOS
agents.label: NR7 breakout up
agents.rule: prior bar has the narrowest range of 7, then a close above its high

agents.name: TETHYS
agents.label: OBV new high before price
agents.rule: OBV at a 20-bar high while the close is not

agents.name: THEIA
agents.label: MACD histogram turns up
agents.rule: histogram below 0 and rising after falling

agents.name: TRITON
agents.label: Heikin-Ashi turns green
agents.rule: first green Heikin-Ashi candle after 3 red

agents.name: VESTA
agents.label: RSI bearish divergence
agents.rule: close above the highest close of bars 5-20 back while RSI(14) is >= 3 lower than at that high (which was > 65)

agents.name: ZEPHYR
agents.label: Loss of the 24h VWAP
agents.rule: close crosses below the rolling 24h VWAP

agents.name: ARGUS
agents.label: Three outside down
agents.rule: bearish engulfing, then a lower close

agents.name: ALTAIR
agents.label: OBV new high before price
agents.rule: OBV at a 20-bar high while the close is not

agents.name: DENEB
agents.label: Heikin-Ashi turns red
agents.rule: first red Heikin-Ashi candle after 3 green

agents.name: ANTARES
agents.label: Doji after a drop
agents.rule: after a 5-bar drop; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: CASTOR
agents.label: Break of structure up (trend continuation)
agents.rule: higher highs and higher lows, then a close above the last swing high

exits: limit 0.1% under the close (3 bars), stop 4x ATR of the timeframe, one exit at 2R, 96h, NDAX fees
